Title: 486115-2026: France – Architectural services for buildings – La CCI Occitanie is publishing on behalf of SCI PARC DES EXPOSITIONS de Nîmes a project management contract for the rehabilitation of the Parc des Expositions in Nîmes
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Refurbishment of a Parc des Expositions (trade fair/exhibition hall complex) is highly relevant for sbp due to long-span structures and exhibition halls. Slightly lower priority because it is an architectural contract in France and not a clearly defined checking engineer contract in Germany.
titel: Design services for the refurbishment of the Nîmes exhibition centre
kurzbeschreibung: Refurbishment of the exhibition centre in Nîmes with architectural and engineering design services.
umfang: Refurbishment of the Parc des Expositions in Nîmes at the site 230 Avenue Du Languedoc; specific areas, spans, gross floor area, hall geometries or technical parameters are not specified in the notice; planned project duration 48 months from 30.10.2026.
leistungen: Maîtrise d'oeuvre or design services for the refurbishment; architectural services for buildings as well as architectural and engineering services and planning-related services; specific specialist lots and work stages are not specified in the notice.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Trade fair and exhibition grounds suggest potentially large hall or roof structures with possible relevance for sbp.
• Refurbishment of an existing complex may require demanding structural concepts for the existing structure.
• Currently only general maîtrise d'oeuvre and architectural/engineering services are mentioned; specific structural engineering tasks are not yet described.
• Early procedural stage in a restricted procedure offers a strategic opportunity to enter via the design team or an architectural office.
• Location in France is generally relevant for sbp, but without any apparent special watchlist or German checking engineer relevance.
• Lack of information on spans, hall sizes and construction costs limits the prioritisation.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the notice. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of information on gross floor area, number and size of halls, depth of intervention in the refurbishment, scope of structural works, façade and roof refurbishment, and technical requirements. Given the project type (exhibition grounds), a potentially larger volume can generally be assumed, but there is no reliable data basis.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee is stated. A realistic estimate is not possible, as neither construction costs nor detailed scopes of services, disciplines, work stages or the share of structural design are specified.
auftraggeber: PARC DES EXPOSITIONS DE NÎMES, 230 Avenue Du Languedoc, 30918 Nîmes, France; Contact person: SCI PARC DES EXPOSITIONS; E-mail: achats@occitanie.cci.fr; Telephone: 0466849339; Website: https://www.expo-nimes.com; Procurement platform: https://www.marches-publics.gouv.fr/entreprise
notes: Restricted procedure. After selection of candidates, the invitation to submit tenders is expected in the last week of August 2026, specified as 30.08.2026. Electronic submission required. Procedure language French. No variants. No framework agreement.
